title: Tell Sabi Abyad, Syria: An Interpretation of Stable Isotope Values of Faunal Bone Collagen
version: Radiocarbon 54(3–4), pp. 281–289, doi:10.1017/S003382220004707X. Cambridge’s web release is dated 2016.
lineage: Original faunal specimens and measurements, with overlapping site investigators. A separate observational line about herd management, not a duplicate sherd assay.

passages.note: Faunal assemblages and stable isotope measurements document local herds and management changes. The cited milk attribution itself comes from ceramic residue and zooarchaeological studies; the bone isotopes alone do not identify a dairy product.
